notes: Daily Yamamoto-first delta review under current main-branch authority. Primary checks covered ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, Space M&A, KEYSTONE CLUB TOKYO and current Tsuyoshi Yamamoto schedule traces before moving through Tokyo/Kanto and official presenter calendars across the Washington-to-New York corridor. The verified Yamamoto dates remain represented canonically and no new Yamamoto delta was admitted. Canonical, active, processed, review and editorial-exclusion records were checked before admission. Stage 1 admits New York Voices because COTTON CLUB announced the group's final Japanese performances inside its documented Grand Finale retirement tour, not merely because the group is famous. Stage 2 assigns S after challenging A+ and S+: farewell finality makes A+ insufficient, while four Tokyo dates, two sets per date and a broader finale tour make S+ excessive. Stage 1 admits Mohini Dey because the solo billing places a virtuoso bass-led artist in Blue Note's intimate club format; stage 2 assigns A because six sets and a prior Blue Note engagement remove scarcity and the exact supporting lineup is not yet announced. Stage 1 admits Al Di Meola because the acoustic-ensemble format foregrounds his rhythmic and melodic guitar language rather than offering generic legacy billing; stage 2 assigns A+ because the context merits active prioritization, while twelve sets across six dates preclude S. COTTON CLUB's other November 4 announcements were reviewed but not admitted because anniversary or established annual-series framing alone did not establish performance-specific value. This is ordinary concert discovery, not the separate Cultural Discovery thread.

events.subtitle: Farewell Tour 2027 — final Japanese performances

priority_review.rationale: The scarcity is performance-specific: COTTON CLUB explicitly presents these four dates as New York Voices' final performances in Japan, while the group's own site says the quartet is ending after 38 years and touring one last time. A+ was challenged and judged insufficient because the farewell context cannot recur after the ensemble disbands. S+ would overstate the evidence because Tokyo receives four dates with two sets each and the group is completing a wider Grand Finale tour that includes a planned final New York concert.

events.category: Vocal jazz / Farewell tour / Final Japanese performances
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents New York Voices' Farewell Tour 2027 from January 16 through January 19, 2027 and describes the engagement as the group's final live performances in Japan. January 16 and 17 have sets at 16:30 and 19:30, with doors at 15:30 and 18:30; January 18 and 19 have sets at 18:00 and 20:30, with doors at 17:00 and 19:45. The announced quartet of Kim Nazarian, Lauren Kinhan, Peter Eldridge and Darmon Meader is joined by pianist Sean Fitzpatrick, bassist Hervé Jeanne and drummer Gabriel Hahn. Table seats are ¥11,000, with other reserved categories from ¥12,000 to ¥13,500 per person. JAM SESSION presale begins November 10 and general web reservations begin November 16.

en.why_it_matters: New York Voices are closing a 38-year group history built on four distinct improvising singers moving as one ensemble. COTTON CLUB is not selling a generic legacy set: these are the quartet's final Japanese performances, with their working rhythm section in the close-range Marunouchi room.
en.trip_verdict: Protect one of the Tokyo sets if the city is reachable during January 16–19. Eight performances provide flexibility, but there will not be another Japanese engagement after the group closes this chapter.
en.listen_before: Reminiscing in Tempo — New York Voices

es.why_it_matters: New York Voices cierra 38 años de historia grupal construida por cuatro cantantes improvisadores capaces de moverse como un solo ensamble. COTTON CLUB no vende un simple repaso de catálogo: serán sus últimas actuaciones en Japón, con su sección rítmica de trabajo y a pocos metros del público.
es.trip_verdict: Protegería uno de los sets si Tokio está al alcance entre el 16 y el 19 de enero. Las ocho funciones dan margen para escoger, pero después de este cierre ya no habrá otra visita japonesa del grupo.

events.factual_description: Blue Note New York presents Mohini Dey for six performances from February 9 through February 11, 2027, with sets at 20:00 and 22:30 each night. Doors are listed at 18:00 for the early sets and 22:00 for the late sets. The venue bills Dey as bassist, arranger, producer and vocalist; no supporting musicians or event-specific program are announced on the primary page. Blue Note links a separate authorized TicketWeb destination for each performance and lists a $20 food-and-drink minimum, which is not recorded as the ticket price.

en.why_it_matters: Dey treats electric bass as lead voice, rhythmic engine and harmonic instrument at once. Blue Note's compact room should make the physical detail of that technique unusually legible, even though the supporting lineup and program remain unannounced.
en.trip_verdict: A worthwhile choice if New York and one of the six sets already fit the schedule. The broad availability and repeat club context do not warrant rearranging the trip around it.

es.why_it_matters: Dey usa el bajo eléctrico como voz principal, motor rítmico e instrumento armónico al mismo tiempo. La cercanía de Blue Note puede volver especialmente visible el detalle físico de esa técnica, aunque todavía no se anuncian acompañantes ni programa.
es.trip_verdict: Es una buena opción si Nueva York y alguno de los seis sets ya caben en la agenda. La disponibilidad amplia y el regreso al mismo club no justifican reorganizar el viaje alrededor del concierto.

Stage 1 rests on the announced acoustic-ensemble format, which concentrates Di Meola's syncopated guitar language, rather than legacy status alone. Stage 2 assigns A+ because that exact format merits active prioritization in New York, while twelve performances across six nights make S-level scarcity indefensible.

en.why_it_matters: The acoustic-ensemble frame strips Di Meola's language back to the difficult part: interlocking rhythm, fast articulation and melody without electric weight doing the dramatic work. Blue Note's room should put that precision and the ensemble conversation under a magnifying glass.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one set if a New York trip overlaps the six-night run. Twelve performances make access unusually flexible, so this is not a reason to rebuild the trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: El formato acústico deja el lenguaje de Di Meola frente a su parte más difícil: ritmo entrelazado, articulación veloz y melodía sin que el peso eléctrico haga el trabajo dramático. La cercanía de Blue Note puede poner bajo lupa tanto esa precisión como la conversación del ensamble.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a uno de los sets si un viaje a Nueva York coincide con esas seis noches. Las doce funciones dan mucha flexibilidad, así que no es motivo para rehacer el viaje por sí solo.
